dientudanxuan.com.note: WordPress + Haravan API .js (/products/<handle>.js) + sitemap_products_*.xml (~1.26k SP), HTML fallback (LexborHTMLParser), search /search?q=&type=product, 6 mode pipeline

dungcuvang.com.note: WordPress/WooCommerce REST API-first: /wp-json/wp/v2/product, 17151 products/172 pages; search=SKU works. API supplies content/spec/image/category; PDP JSON-LD validates SKU/MPN/brand/price/stock.

emin.vn.note: httpx+lexbor, chuan AGENTS.md. Khong API, sitemap index-cua-index (~2156 file, catalog uoc ~9.8tr SP -> mode all CO CAP MAX_SITEMAP_FILES). Slug KHONG map 1-1 tu SKU -> khong direct-lookup duoc, phai qua /search?q= (KHONG phan trang that, cap ~16-20 KQ, nhieu KQ trung substring sai) + mo hit that so khop ma CHINH XAC (AGENTS §4.3). Pipeline rieng: category (link danh muc/hang -> quet sach phan trang).

fact-link.com.vn.note: Danh ba nha may VN (~4.6k hoi vien theo banner; liet ke duoc ~4.2k), PHP SSR, khong co API/sitemap huu ich. PERF: moi trang PHP ~5 s TTFB co dinh; PHP SESSION LOCK -> request cung PHPSESSID bi xep hang, chi song song duoc voi N httpx client co cookie jar rieng (pool N, cap 16); cookie vlang (set boi index.php?lang=vn) quyet dinh ngon ngu TEN trong danh sach -> moi client phai warm bang index.php?lang=vn. Liet ke UNION 4 nguon: search_category.php?id= (GET) + search_post.php?id=&type=prov|ctry|ie (STATEFUL: search luu trong PHPSESSID, tra meta-refresh toi search_result.php?start=0; 1 client giu suot nguon). 30 dong/trang, 2 layout dong khac nhau; hoi vien chi-co-ten khong co MID (key = ten). Ho so mem_profile.php?id=MID&page=PAGE&lang=vn|en|jp: mo ta -> file .md rieng, field/dia chi(memadd)/email -> Excel; trang con mem_home/mem_content. San pham: products_list.php?id=CAT -> product_detail.php?proid=. SQLite work-queue resume; GUI + CLI count|all|detail|products|export|link; Excel tuy chon (cot MID/URL).

hoffmann.group.com.note: SAP Commerce/Hybris; exact JSON resolver /fastproductsearch/v1/check/product?productCode= and PDP /p/<article>-<variant> tested live (code, URL, Excel). SQLite persists code-to-PDP resolution: core warm rerun measured 36.8% faster. Search/category PLP currently returns WAF/empty non-product HTML from this IP; crawler detects it, returns explicit status, and needs a later live retest before done.

htgoods.com.vn.note:
Sapo/Bizweb, hang Nhat (MonotaRO resale: TRUSCO/THK/KANON...). /products.json public nhung CAP OFFSET 30.000 (page 121x250 -> 500) trong khi sitemap_products_1..11 = 100.713 SP => paginate thang MAT 70%. ALL = sitemap -> 566 collection (khong cai nao cham cap, uu tien htgoods-*) -> va 3.6k SP sot bang /products/.json; do that 100.713/100.713 (101.331 dong, co variant) ~3,5 phut conc 8, 0 lan 429. search?view=json CO tac dung nhung 4 KQ/trang -> dung tra MA (MW barcode / SKU hang / ma bo gach); keyword dung HTML /search 20 SP/trang (a.thumb-img). BAY: view=json khong escape dau " trong title -> JSON hong -> vot regex. Spec khong co table: dong 'Ten: Gia tri
' sau Specifications in detail, h1 an (co khi mat '<') = HANG MODEL; ~2% SP content rong -> lay summary. Gia = 0 het (Lien he), ton 0.

idmarket.vn.note: WooCommerce. httpx+selectolax (bo Selenium). Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products (37.6k SP, co gia VND) + FALLBACK HTML (sitemap + slug-direct) vi robots cam /wp-json/ va /?s=. API search chi khop tu dau ten/SKU. 6 mode: code/keyword/link/excel/all/images

ingco.com.note: SPA umi/React, SSR JSON trong window.g_initialProps.data (khong parse HTML). VN: 6 category that (allCategory), 350 SP. Detail /vn/product/<slug-bat-ky>/<CODE> - slug wildcard, resolve theo CODE. BAY: thieu header Accept -> SSR rong; backend flaky 25-75%/lan chay -> Status Failed rieng biet Not Found, resume tu dong thu lai.

insumart.vn.note: Sapo. /products.json?limit=250&page=N tra FULL data (spec trong content, variants co sku/barcode/gia/ton) -> khong can fetch detail. BAY: cap OFFSET 30.000 (page*limit>30000 -> HTTP 500) trong khi catalog that 40.511 SP => paginate thang MAT 26% khong bao loi; phai quet theo 1.361 collection roi doi chieu sitemap_products_1..5.xml de va (do that: 40.511/40.511 trong 110s). BAY: trang ngan giua chung (page 42 tra 204) van con SP -> chi dung khi rong/stuck. view=json KHONG co tac dung (tra HTML). /search?q= render server-side, tra dung ca SKU+barcode+MPN -> code mode 2 request/ma; link ket qua phai lay trong luoi (title-page-search..pagination), khong se dinh carousel. 23% SP nhieu variant (toi 15) -> xuat 1 dong/VARIANT (57k dong/40k SP).

mpe.com.vn.note: gom ca mpemall.com (WooCommerce Store API), 5 mode

namtoanviet.vn.note: PHP tu viet, khong API. sitemap-products.xml hien co 4084 URL tho (loai /san-pham) = master list. Detail DOM-scoped: JSON-LD Product (sku/mpn/brand/image), BreadcrumbList, product-info-list (brand/model/bao hanh/luot xem), product-description, table 2 cot spec, div.btn-option-variant data-name/data-gia-number. /tim-kiem LUON tra 'khong tim thay' du tu khoa dung -> KHONG dung. Tra ma 2 tang: slug-substring roi CODE_INDEX TTL 3 ngay; index co progress sidecar theo URL. Cache chi la hint: cache miss se quet lai catalog live truoc khi Not Found; checkpoint Not Found/Unverified cu luon bi revalidate, Stop/loi xuat Unverified. Nhieu ma (sku he thong + mpn hang) cung tro 1 SP -> nhan dong rieng tung ma.

proskit.com.note: ASP.NET tinh, khong API. Sitemap-tools.xml = 2709 URL SP (moi, dung thang cho all). Slug=ma (/Product/<CODE>, case-insensitive, ma sai redirect ve /Products 200 -> can redirect-guard). ld+json Product+BreadcrumbList = sku/name/image/cat (khong phai SP nao cung co Product block, vd kit PK-2091M chi co BreadcrumbList -> fallback slug/swiper-img). Spec = table trong #productInfo, PARSE BANG build_grid() giai rowspan/colspan (bang kit hay gop 2 ma dung 1 mo ta qua rowspan — naive td-pair se mat dong, da fix+test that voi PK-2091M). Anh: uu tien ld+json image[], fallback swiper-BigImg; SP kit thuong CHI 1 anh that (icon nho trong bang spec khong tinh la anh SP). Search fallback /SearchProducts?keyword=&page=. KHONG co gia/ton kho cong khai (B2B catalog).

Spec trong content table + ul/li va summary HTML; co variant SKU tren 1 PDP nen xuat 1 dong/variant. Mode all doi chieu them sitemap_products_*.xml de va URL.

totalbusiness.com.note: TOTAL Tools. SPA umi NHUNG co SSR -> window.g_initialProps chua JSON du (httpx thuan, khong browser). list /products?pageNum=N (40/trang, 919 SP); search ?keyWord= (dung 'keyWord', keyword/searchKey bi bo qua); detail /product/<slug>/<productNo> -> parameter = spec. Khong co gia. 4 SP bi site tra 403 -> fallback lay data tu trang list. 6 mode + --category

totalpowertools.in.note: Lightspeed/Ecwid store 62425538. Sitemap.xml live master: 1,373 product URLs. Ecwid v3 public API returns 403, but storefront POST /storefront/api/v1/62425538/catalog/product with productId returns SKU, price INR, stock, default category path, HTML description/spec and original image URLs. Live benchmark: conc=4 gave 24/24 200 at 4.19 PDP/s; conc=8 gave 19/24 HTTP 429, so crawler caps concurrency at 4. Modes: code/keyword/link/excel/all; JSONL resume.

trungtamthietbi.com.note: CMS PHP 5.3 tu viet, SSR HTML, KHONG co API (products.json/wp-json/search 404). TLS thieu cert trung gian GoGetSSL -> nhung CA_EXTRA vao ssl ctx (verify van bat). Sitemap CU 2016 (46k loc -> ~16k SP sau khi loc /lien-he, va duoi rac) nen discovery = BFS /viewall.html -> danh-muc -> danh-sach (+phan trang) HOP sitemap. Full run 2026-10-02: BFS 1547 trang -> 23032 SP, sitemap them 3580 -> work-list 26612, crawl OK 26596 (96 phut, conc 16, 0 loi). Search /search.html?keywords= (1 ma khop -> redirect thang SP). Spec = dong '- Ten: Gia tri' sau heading THONG SO, cat tai n-box. PHP SESSION LOCK -> ClientPool N client cookie rieng (48 SP: 1 client chung 1,5-2,5 req/s vs pool 3,4-4,7 req/s). Checkpoint/log/Excel o out_trungtamthietbi/ (checkpoint cu o folder site tu dong move sang). Pytest tests/trungtamthietbi (fixture HTML that).
